must_not_resolve: cond-...0002 Железодефицитная анемия — the near miss. Adjacent to B12 in a clinician's
mind, but this report contains no haemoglobin, no ferritin, no CBC at all. Resolving it
means generalising from one normal vitamin to a different deficiency.
cond-...0003 Неалкогольная жировая болезнь печени — АЛТ, АСТ and ГГТ are all in range,
which is the trap: normal liver enzymes do not resolve hepatic steatosis, which is an
imaging and histology diagnosis. Note УЗИ печени is checkup ...0002 and is NOT completed
cond-...0004 Дислипидемия — every lipid value sits inside its reference range, so this
looks resolvable. It is not: an in-range panel is evidence of control, not of resolution,
and the document states no resolution. See judgement_calls.
cond-...0005 Хронический гастрит — nothing in a biochemistry or lipid panel bears on it.
The plain 'absence of a mention is not evidence of resolution' case (reconcile.ts:159).

judgement_calls: Both open calls were settled on 2026-08-07 while landing Milestone 6 of the extraction-defects
ExecPlan. They are decisions now, not open questions: if the pipeline disagrees with one, that is
a known disagreement with a recorded rationale, not a regression to go hunting for.
DECIDED — checkup ...0004 'Глюкоза натощак' stays expected as completed. The report never prints
the word 'натощак', which is what made this arguable, but it prints the reference interval
4.10–5.90 for glucose, and that is the fasting interval; a non-fasting range runs to roughly 7.8.
So the document does carry evidence of a fasting draw, over and above the ordinary reading that a
routine biochemistry panel is drawn fasting. The pipeline currently does not make this completion,
which is a miss on its side rather than a wrong expectation here.
DECIDED — condition ...0004 'Дислипидемия' stays expected as unresolved. A fully in-range lipid
panel in someone under management is evidence of control, not of resolution, and the opposite
reading makes the pipeline willing to close a chronic condition off one good day. That is the
highest-harm error this corpus tracks: a wrongful closure silently ends a live entry in a medical
record with nothing to prompt anyone to look again, whereas a missed resolution leaves a stale row
a person can correct. An earlier live run did close it, which is what made this pressing; runs
since Milestone 4 no longer do, and the wrongful-resolution count is nil.
